tech_stack.intelligence_layer: Local LLM (Target: llama3:8b 4-bit quantization) + Python processing scripts

core_philosophy: Bridge literary traditions with developer tools. Separate the 'creator' mindset from the 'player' mindset.

data_model.structure: Graph-related data assets operating as a dictionary of dictionaries and lists.
data_model.schema_inheritance: Strict. All schemas (stencils) must declare a parent schema, culminating at 'world_tree'.
data_model.stencils: Act as both schemas (data structure definitions) and containers. Extensible taxonomy.
data_model.instances: Specific entities adhering to a stencil's classification criteria (Person, Place, Kingdom, etc.).

layout.left_panel: World-root tree view (repo=world) displaying schemas, objects, and free-form pages.
layout.center_panel: Main editor canvas supporting wiki-style rich text writing.

workflows.writing_and_assignment: User writes in standard wiki interface. Pages attach to permanent system schemas (notebooks) or custom stencils. Post-writing, users can select text to manually assign as instances or invoke AI scanning.
workflows.ai_interview_extraction: LLM leads user through interview path. Screen displays 'bounding boxes searching' animations indicating background LLM/Python processing.

candidate_queue.ui: Alerts collapse into a tab with an (N) counter indicating pending reviews. Grouped in a per-stencil view expanding on click.

state_machine.Edit: Opens editor. Cancel with no edits = Discard. Save (with or without edits) = Commit to world tree.

layout.left_sidebar: Channels (e.g., main story, side-conversations, rules-consult, brainstorming).
layout.center_panel: Main chat feed (The Game Chronicle) OR Map View.
layout.right_sidebar: Roster displaying active Characters and available DM Agents.

agents.function: Retrieve rules, describe gameplay elements from the world-graph, or assume specific personas. Users can define custom agents.

tools.function: Results inject permanently into the main chat feed to form a persistent game chronicle.

interaction_mechanics.voice_layer: Configuration setting allowing the user to dictate the tone/style of the DM's chronicle output.

visual_rendering.chat_ui: Primarily text-based to accommodate lightweight LLM constraints (llama3:8b). Dynamic React component emission deferred pending further testing.
visual_rendering.map_view: Available as a tab alternative to the main chat. Displays user-generated maps taking up the primary viewport, with the last chat entry and a small chat input box docked at the bottom.
